title: Vaya
text: 1-3 Sāvatthi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Rādho Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Vayadhammo vayadhammoti bhante vuccati || || Katamo nu kho bhante vayadhammoti || || 4 Rūpaṃ kho Rādha vayadhammo || vedanā vayadhammo || saññā || saṅkhārā vayadhammo || viññāṇaṃ vayadhammo || || 5 Evam passaṃ || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
